invocation.reason: STAR structure improves through repeated classification, feedback, and transfer practice

user.audience: New graduate preparing for behavioral interviews
user.level: Has project experience but answers are often unstructured
constraints: Do not store free-text answers or voice

goal.outcome: Recognize and construct well-structured STAR interview responses
successCriteria: Correctly classifies Situation, Task, Action, Result in three examples
Completes one transfer item without a hint

sourceNotes: Use fictional response fragments and structured selections only

experience.primaryLoop: classify or repair response segment -> submit -> receive targeted feedback -> retry or transfer
experience.completionState: Classification streak, two repairs, and transfer item completed

agentQuestions: Which STAR component is most often omitted?
Can the learner distinguish actions from team-level descriptions?
Does structure transfer to a new example?
